modalLead: Four Beszel widgets show how your other machines are doing. Config is calmer: one pane, hints under their settings and the Appearance tabs on one line.

items.text: Four Beszel widgets. They read your Beszel hub: every system with its processor, memory and disk, one system in full, only the systems that need a look, and every disk. Add the hub's address and a login, press Connect, and tick the systems you want. A system that is down says so, never the readings from before.
items.title: Four Beszel widgets for your machines

media.alt: A page with four Beszel widgets: every system with its processor, memory and disk, one system in full with its processor over the last hour, the systems that need a look, and the fullest disks

items.text: A service that could not be reached no longer says its sign-in was refused. Widgets that sign in now say the service could not be reached when it never answered, so you are not sent to retype a password that was right.

Config is calmer. It is one pane now, easier to read on glass. A short line under a setting says what it does, and an ℹ stays only where there is more to read. The way to the Bookmarks view and the Inbox stands in the same place in both, and Statistics opens on a Summary tab.
Appearance's tabs fit on one line. Theme and Previews have shorter names.
Unraid opens on its connection. The address and key come first, with the widgets under them; How it works is a tab of its own.
Confetti keeps the // and the widget icon in its headers.
The Containers table fits a laptop window. Its columns give way to the width of the list, not of the window.
The Bookmarks view fits a laptop window. Its header stays see-through until you scroll, and its toolbar wraps instead of covering the search box.
